title: A re-run whose service dates overlap a run of another period, or a run still being priced
assertion: A run of another period that took effect after the original and was priced after the re-run, or under a later release, refuses it (`superseded`). No shared line goes back to older pricing, and re-running the original again is accepted. One priced before the re-run does not refuse it, and its own lines stay in effect. A run pinned to a withdrawn release does not count as newer. A first run of overlapping dates being priced refuses acceptance (`newer_run_pending`). One queued refuses new re-runs but not acceptance, and when it completes it takes effect after the accepted re-run
noFileReason: No file of its own: SYNTHETIC 835s the pricing world already loads.
